svg.aria-label: Cell for the stability window: SS | electrolyte | Li. The lithium on the negative cap side serves as both counter and reference electrode, and the stainless steel is the working electrode. Green and blue go to the stainless steel; white, red and orange go to the lithium. In the software, vs Eref means vs Li. Use a new cell for each scan.

svg.text: SS / electrolyte / Li: Li on cap side
